mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 58 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park, with a First Quarter moon shining tonight. You can spot the International Space Station flying overhead starting at 5:42 AM, rising near Mount Horeb and heading northeast toward Madison, reaching high in the sky. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 42 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday where a school bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired. Officers stopped the bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, confirming that while the driver was impaired, alcohol was not a factor, and no students or members of the public were injured during the event.

It is a busy weekend for entertainment, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company taking place today. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or participate in various trivia nights starting on Tuesday at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving, and they are currently investigating a potential collision with a sign outside the city.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Mint Cookie. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until their 10 PM closing time tonight.
